notes.title: Version 1.2.6 update
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.6 is now available.

Changes:


 Fixed a bug that didn't allow to progress between scenes when Windows language and/or locale was in languages other than English
 A few characters assets have been updated, they were scaled down by accident at some point during development
 Fixed a few typos in Episode 2

Thank you.

notes.title: 'Episode 2: Raid & Fortress' poster and release date
notes.notes:
After 2 years, we are almost done with Episode 2. We just need to finish up some animations and complete some scripts and the episode will be ready for release. Episode 2 will be available as paid DLC ($5) on October 4th, 2024. 

Twice as long and thrice the amount of art.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40480033/5cefec16a063dc4e2cde05ba4fb3dd7c62a31845.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078750/The_Scorchfarer__Episode_2_Raid__Fortress/

On the same day we will also release a bundle with Episode 2, Episode 1 Artbook and Soundtrack (updated with Episode 2 songs). We will make sure to make the game Steam Deck ready in the upcoming month after release. Wishlist now!

Thank you!

notes.title: The Scorchfarer Demo release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40480033/de9e2cf6f166fb2fa5cf0925ac7a283e556c3941.jpg

We are very excited to make the demo public for everyone. Thank you for your patience.

Please contact us for any feedback you have or problems you may find.

We are working really hard to complete the first episode, it should be done by around mid-March. We hope you continue to support us.

Michiyuki Project
